title: Persona Non Grata
dialogue: Danika's counterintelligence report identified four Arcturian diplomatic personnel operating as intelligence officers under embassy cover. The question now is what to do with that information.
monologue: Four names. Four people who recruited a twenty-three year old woman, blackmailed her with her brother's debt, and ran a cabinet-level intelligence operation inside Veltria's government for the better part of a year. The law is clear. The diplomatic calculus is not.

choices.text: Expel all four. Declare them persona non grata and give them 48 hours to leave Veltrian territory. Issue a formal diplomatic protest.
Expel the primary handler only — the one who recruited Yelena Dorova. Inform the Arcturian ambassador privately. No public statement.

narrative.text: The Arcturian ambassador has filed a formal protest. He describes the expulsions as politically motivated and disproportionate. The Arcturian press is running stories about Veltrian instability and anti-western paranoia. Ambassador Cole has requested an urgent meeting.
None of this is unexpected. They will make noise for two weeks and then adjust. The intelligence operation is shut down. That is the result. The noise is the cost.

choices.text: Meet with Ambassador Cole. Lay out the evidence. Veltria's action was lawful and proportionate.

narrative.text: The ambassador acknowledged the expulsion without comment. The other three officers have been quietly reassigned. No public statement from either side. The operation is effectively closed.
The Arcturians will remember this was handled discreetly. That is worth something — not trust, but the awareness that we know how to be quiet when quiet serves everyone.

choices.text: Noted. Monitor for any replacement operation.
